lines.zh: 我从遗迹的阴影里走出来
lines.en: I step out of the ruin's shadow.
My black scales swallow the light.

lines.zh: 我一爪一爪地走过石板
lines.en: I cross the flagstones claw by claw.
I patrol along the wall.
My tail sweeps the broken tiles.
I circle the ruin once.

lines.zh: 我从断裂的柱子后绕出
lines.en: I come round a broken pillar.
I press forward, step by step.
I open my wings a little at a time.
I snap a bone underfoot.
I walk into the wind.
I stop in the middle of the entrance.
I crouch on the broken wall.

lines.zh: 我的爪子刨着遗迹的沙。
lines.en: My claws rake the ruin's sand.
I lie still and only watch.
My wings lie folded on my back.
I turn my head slowly.

lines.zh: 我在听石板上有没有脚步
lines.en: I listen for steps on the flagstones.
The wind comes through the gap.
My claws grip the stone seams.
I wait for someone to come in.
I lie still without shifting a scale.
My scales lie one over another.
The ancient egg was here.
Guarding these ruins is enough.
You should not enter this ruin.
I know the look of egg-thieves.
Walk back out through that door.
I have guarded here a long while.
What are your hands looking for?
I lower my head and see you clearly.
Nothing here belongs to you.
I get to my feet, bit by bit.
Go no further in.
I draw my claws back half a pace.
A line appears on my scales.
I have marked that on my scales.
I growl and fold my wings.
My claws dig in.
I recover by degrees.
All four of my claws are still under me.
I shake the ash off my hide.
This wound is nowhere near enough.
I am still holding the doorway.
These are not for the living.
These bright stones — I don't eat them.
Set it down on the ground.
Everything here has an owner.
I only answer to the smell of fire.
My gaze is pinned to your hand.
Put it down and step back.
That buys you nothing.
I have no interest at all.
You hit my chest plates.
My horns shove you back a step.

lines.zh: 你的脚跟压住我的尾巴
lines.en: Your heel is on my tail.
My wing brushes you.
I walk past you.
We crack the flagstones.
That should move you back.
I fold my wings and yield the sand.
Do not stand across the doorway.

lines.zh: 我是从远古蛋里出来的
lines.en: I came from an ancient egg.
I am alone in this ruin.
I have not thought of such things.
That is not a thing to ask.
I turn and walk into the ruins.
Guarding this ruin is enough.
I fold both wings onto my back.
There has only ever been me here.
A muffled growl rolls in my throat.
I go back to patrolling the broken walls.
Everything in the ruin is mine.
My scales scrape it bright.
This smells old.
I fling it back.
It slips from my claws.
Whoever brought it in, I do not care.
I crush it.
This is worth almost nothing.
I carry it behind the broken wall.
I have no use for this.
You broke into my ruin.
I have come down from the wall.
You have fallen into my sight.
You are too close to the egg.
My wings are at their widest.
I will not be gentle.

lines.zh: 你听见我的爪子声了吗
lines.en: Do you hear my claws?
Things come in here and do not leave.
I have waited long enough for you.
You are backed into the corner.
I leap down off the broken wall.
I leave that stone.
I move along the broken wall.
I have come round behind you.
You turn, and I stop.

lines.zh: 我的黑鳞在暗处看不见
lines.en: My black scales vanish in the dark.
I silently count the steps you take.
The door will not help you.
I keep following.

lines.zh: 这里的回音把你的位置告诉我
lines.en: The echoes tell me where you are.
I open my wings slowly.
I shift a little nearer.
I know every part of this ruin.
Do you hear the wings?
I wait for the last moment.
Everything on my side is ready.
I burst out of the dark.
My claws rip open your shoulder.
You fall back to the pillar.
That blow had full weight.
My teeth bite into your armour.
One toss of my head throws you off.
My wings raise a cloud of dust.
You have actually got up again.
I come on once more.
Blood is on my black scales.
That should make it clear.
I draw my claws back half a pace.
There is a stone wall at your back.
I do not intend to let you out.
I hatched from the ancient egg.
A dark shape joins the ruin.
My scales are new.

lines.zh: 我从龙之手的残骸里出来
lines.en: I come from the wreck of the Drakvyrn Hand.
I rise slowly to my feet.
I shake the ash off my hide.
The air here is old.
I scan the ruin.
My claws take the flagstones.
I stop in the doorway.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，看着破洞里的天
lines.en: I raise my head to the hole in the roof.
The dust here is thick.
I chose the highest broken wall.
I wait for someone to come.
I begin my rounds of the ruin.
Flame licks across my black scales.
I fall off the broken wall.
Water fills my throat.
The blast throws me into a pillar.

lines.zh: 一支箭嵌在我鳞片缝里
lines.en: An arrow wedges between my scales.
Magic burns in through my joints.
There is nothing to eat in this ruin.
Lightning strikes the ruin's roof.

lines.zh: 我脚下的石板一下没了
lines.en: The flagstones under me are gone.
